name: 66th ERSA Congress (ERSA2027): Regions and Cities in an Era of Geopolitical Risks
conf_dates_note: Congress page gives both "23-26 August 2027" and "24 to 27 August 2027"
call_type: Special session proposals (general call for abstracts/papers to follow)
deadline_note: Deadline for special session proposals. The general call for abstracts/papers is not yet published (2026 Congress: abstracts/papers due 20 Feb 2026).
submission_requirements: Special session proposal via online form (Word template available): convenor contact details, co-convenors, title, description and four interested presenters; at least 4 registered presenters per session; presenters then apply with a (draft) paper or extended abstract through the ERSA2027 portal; 20-25 minute slots with discussant
